data.narrative:
Shield AI, a Series G defense and security company, was last valued at $12.7B post-money after raising $1.5B+. The valuation assessment draws on a peer set of 9 same-sector, similar-tier companies (2 public, 8 private), including Anduril Industries ($61.0B Series H), Helsing ($18.0B Series D), and Flock Safety ($7.5B Series G).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 1.25x step-up multiplier from last post-money valuation, implying $15.9B. Peer-median analysis across the 9-company comp set yields $7.5B, with a range spanning $3.0B to $61.0B. The dispersion reflects stage and business-model variation within the defense sector; Anduril's outlier valuation ($61.0B) reflects its Series H maturity and expanded platform scope.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $6.4B (low) to $18.3B (high), with a median of $11.7B. This bands the current $12.7B valuation near the median, suggesting it remains reasonable given stage progression dynamics. Key uncertainties include future funding velocity, competitive intensity within autonomous defense systems, and regulatory/export constraints specific to the sector.
